description: Encodes a stereo pair into mid and side signals and decodes mid and side back into a stereo pair

params.text: Scales the side signal: 0V passes half the difference between In L and In R, -5V removes it and collapses to mono, +5V passes all of it

inputs.text: The left channel of the stereo pair being encoded
The right channel of the stereo pair being encoded
The mid signal to be decoded back to stereo; unpatched it carries Out M
The side signal to be decoded back to stereo; unpatched it carries Out S
Adds to the width setting, in volts

outputs.text: Half the sum of In L and In R
The difference between In R and In L, scaled by Width
